title: FileDiffRequest
description: Parameters of changeset.fileDiff. One file at a time, on demand: the changeset itself carries no diffs.

repositoryPath.description: Absolute path to the worktree root.

path.description: Repository-relative path of the file, as it appears in the changeset.

previousPath.description: The file's path at HEAD when it was renamed or copied, so the diff shows the move rather than an unrelated add.

untracked.description: True when the file is untracked. Git has nothing to compare an unknown file against, so its added side is produced from the file itself.
